scenario.topic: Select a reusable packaging system for the campus café

options.name: Reusable Plastic Containers with QR Code Tracking
options.upside: Allows easy tracking and return of containers through QR codes.
options.concern: Plastic may retain odors and requires regular inspection for wear.

options.name: Stainless Steel Containers with Deposit System
options.upside: Durable and resistant to stains and odors, with a simple deposit return process.
options.concern: Heavier containers may be less convenient for some customers to carry.

options.name: Glass Jars with Silicone Lids
options.upside: Non-reactive and easy to clean, with clear visibility of contents.
options.concern: Fragility increases risk of breakage during handling and transport.

options.name: Collapsible Silicone Containers
options.upside: Flexible and space-saving when not in use, with barcode tracking for returns.
options.concern: Silicone may retain stains and requires careful cleaning to avoid odors.

shared_context: The campus café plans to implement a reusable packaging system to reduce waste and support sustainability goals. The system must be compatible with existing kitchen equipment, easy for customers to use, and manageable by café staff.

personas.name: Maya
personas.background: Maya is a sustainability coordinator passionate about innovative, space-saving solutions.
personas.private_goal: Ensure the packaging system is flexible and easy for customers to carry and store.

A.reason_for: QR code tracking supports easy returns and management.
A.reason_against: Plastic containers may retain odors, which concerns hygiene.

B.reason_for: Durability is good but heavier weight may reduce customer convenience.
B.reason_against: Heavier stainless steel containers are less flexible for carrying.

C.reason_for: Glass is easy to clean and visually clear.
C.reason_against: Fragility and risk of breakage make it less practical.

D.reason_for: Collapsible silicone containers save space and have barcode tracking, ideal for convenience and storage.

personas.name: Liam
personas.background: Liam is a café manager focused on operational efficiency and customer satisfaction.
personas.private_goal: Select a system that integrates well with existing processes and is easy for staff to manage.

A.reason_for: QR code tracking allows efficient container tracking and return management.

B.reason_for: Deposit system is straightforward and containers are durable and easy to clean.
B.reason_against: Heavier containers might inconvenience some customers.

C.reason_for: Glass jars are clean and visible but fragile and risky for busy operations.
C.reason_against: Fragility increases breakage risk, complicating staff handling.

D.reason_for: Collapsible design saves space and barcode tracking aids returns.
D.reason_against: Silicone's tendency to retain stains and odors requires extra cleaning effort.

personas.name: Zara
personas.background: Zara is a part-time student who values simplicity and environmental impact.
personas.private_goal: Choose a packaging option that is safe, easy to use, and clearly sustainable.

A.reason_for: Plastic containers are lightweight and trackable.
A.reason_against: Plastic may retain odors and feels less natural.

B.reason_for: Stainless steel is durable but heavy and less convenient to carry.
B.reason_against: Heaviness reduces ease of use, which is important to me.

C.reason_for: Glass jars are non-reactive, easy to clean, and show contents clearly, supporting safety and sustainability.

D.reason_for: Collapsible silicone is flexible and space-saving, with barcode tracking.
D.reason_against: Silicone may retain stains and odors, which worries me slightly.
